units.source_text: 听女人说，正好是半年以前，一个暴风雨之夜，在村西角上的洞穴，

en.t: According to the woman, it had been exactly half a year earlier, on a stormy night, in the pit at the western corner of the village,

units.source_text: 防护栏被风吹毁，房子一半被埋没了。

en.t: the protective fence was blown down by the wind, and half the house was buried.

units.source_text: 接着是雨，裹挟着雨的沙子，比原来重两倍。

en.t: Then came the rain, and the sand mixed with rain became twice as heavy as before.

units.source_text: 房子像火柴盒似的啪地倒塌了，幸好没人受伤。

en.t: The house collapsed with a snap like a matchbox, but fortunately no one was hurt.

units.source_text: 第二天，那一家人试着逃跑。

en.t: The next day, that family tried to run away.

units.source_text: 钟声刚响起来，还没到五分钟，就被人拖去暗道，说是只听见老女人的哭叫声。

en.t: Less than five minutes after the bell began to ring, they were dragged off to the dark passage, and people said only the old woman's wailing could be heard.

units.source_text: 女人还用煞有介事的口吻添加了一句，听人说，

en.t: The woman also added, in a very serious tone, that people said

units.source_text: 那一家子，像是有遗传的脑病……

en.t: that whole family seemed to have some inherited brain disease...
